instruction: For a fictional Data Scientist employed in Rajasthan, India, draft an illustrative employment agreement with INR 1175000 fixed annual salary, a hybrid work arrangement, 42 scheduled hours per week, 3 months of probation, and 90 days of mutual notice. Include parties, appointment, duties, workplace, salary, probation, working time, leave, applicable statutory benefits, confidentiality, work-related IP, workplace policy, termination, disputes and signatures. Use party and date placeholders. Do not invent legal rates, extra payment amounts, or post-employment non-competes; make contractual terms subject to applicable law.
output:
```markdown
1. Parties and Agreement Date  
This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made and entered into on [Date] ("Effective Date") by and between:  

[Educator Name], a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its principal office at [Employer Address] ("Employer"),  

and  

[Employee Name], an individual residing at [Employee Address] ("Employee").  

2. Appointment  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of Data Scientist, effective from [Joining Date]. The Employee accepts this appointment and agrees to perform the duties and responsibilities assigned in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and applicable law.  

3. Duties and Responsibilities  
The Employee shall perform the functions, tasks, and responsibilities customary to the role of a Data Scientist, including but not limited to: developing machine learning models, analyzing large datasets, generating data-driven insights, supporting product development with analytical solutions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. The Employee shall perform these duties diligently, professionally, and in the best interest of the Employer.  

4. Workplace and Work Arrangement  
The Employee’s primary place of work shall be the Employer’s office in Rajasthan, India. However, the Employee shall operate under a hybrid work arrangement, which may include working from the Employer’s premises and remotely from an approved alternate location, as determined by the Employer from time to time. The Employer reserves the right to modify the work arrangement with reasonable notice, subject to operational requirements and applicable law.  

5. Fixed Annual Salary  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of INR 1175000 (One Million One Hundred Seventy-Five Thousand Indian Rupees), payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll practices. This salary is exclusive of any statutory deductions and subject to applicable tax laws. No additional compensation, bonuses, or variable pay is guaranteed under this Agreement unless separately approved in writing by the Employer.  

6. Probation  
The Employee shall undergo a probationary period of three (3) months, commencing from the [Joining Date]. During this period, the Employee’s performance and conduct shall be evaluated. The Employer reserves the right to terminate employment during probation with 90 days’ prior written notice, or the Employee may resign with 90 days’ prior written notice. The terms of this Agreement, including salary and working hours, shall remain fully applicable during the probation period.  

7. Working Hours  
The Employee shall work 42 scheduled hours per week, distributed across five or six days as per the Employer’s operational requirements. The standard working hours may include time spent on-site and remotely, depending on the hybrid work schedule. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to fulfill job responsibilities, subject to compliance with applicable labor laws.  

8. Leave  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave in accordance with the leave policies of the Employer, as may be amended from time to time, and subject to applicable statutory requirements in Rajasthan and central Indian labor legislation. Leave entitlements, including casual, sick, and earned leave, shall be granted in compliance with applicable law and internal policy.  

9. Applicable Statutory Benefits  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under applicable central and state laws, including but not limited to the Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, the Employees’ State Insurance Act (if applicable), and other relevant labor codes. The Employer shall comply with all statutory obligations relating to contributions, filings, and employee entitlements.  

10. Confidentiality  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose or use any confidential information, trade secrets, or proprietary data of the Employer, except as required in the course of employment. This obligation shall continue indefinitely after termination of employment.  

11. Work-Related Intellectual Property  
All intellectual property, including inventions, software, algorithms, models, reports, and data analyses, created by the Employee during employment in the course of duties for the Employer shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee agrees to execute all necessary documents to vest such rights in the Employer.  

12. Workplace Policies  
The Employee shall comply with all current and future workplace policies, codes of conduct, data security protocols, and internal guidelines issued by the Employer, as communicated from time to time.  

13. Termination  
Either party may terminate this Agreement by providing 90 days’ prior written notice to the other party. Termination during or after probation shall be governed by the same notice requirement. The Employer reserves the right to terminate employment summarily for cause in accordance with applicable law.  

14. Dispute Resolution  
Any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussion. If unresolved, the dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Rajasthan, India.  

15. Governing Law  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, including applicable central and state labor legislation in Rajasthan.  

16. Employer and Employee Signatures  

___________________________  
[Educator Name]  
Authorized Signatory  
Date: [Date]  

___________________________  
[Employee Name]  
Employee  
Date: [Date]  
```

instruction: For a fictional IT Operations Analyst employed in Odisha, India, draft an illustrative employment agreement with INR 1400000 fixed annual salary, a hybrid work arrangement, 38 scheduled hours per week, 5 months of probation, and 90 days of mutual notice. and  
[I] [Employee Name], residing at [Employee Address] (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").  

2. Appointment  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee to the position of IT Operations Analyst, effective from [Joining Date]. This appointment is subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement and applicable laws in India.  

3. Duties and Responsibilities  
The Employee shall perform duties related to monitoring, maintaining, and optimizing IT systems and infrastructure, including incident response, system troubleshooting, performance analysis, and coordination with internal and external technical teams. The Employee shall also assist in implementing operational policies, ensuring system security, and supporting digital transformation initiatives as directed by the Employer. The Employee shall perform these responsibilities diligently, professionally, and in compliance with all applicable standards and directives issued by the Employer.  

4. Workplace and Work Arrangement  
The Employee’s primary workplace is in Odisha, India. The Employee shall work under a hybrid work arrangement, which permits a combination of on-site presence at the Employer’s designated office and remote work from an approved location, subject to operational requirements and prior approval by the Employer. The Employer reserves the right to modify the hybrid work schedule with reasonable notice, in accordance with business needs and applicable law.  

5. Fixed Annual Salary  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of INR 1400000, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s standard payroll practices. This salary is exclusive of any statutory deductions and shall not be subject to performance-based adjustments during the term of employment unless otherwise amended in writing by mutual consent.  

6. Probation  
The Employee shall undergo a probation period of five (5) months, commencing from [Joining Date]. During this period, the Employee’s performance and conduct will be assessed. The Employer or the Employee may terminate employment during probation by providing ninety (90) days’ written notice or payment in lieu of notice, as per the terms in Section 13. The terms of this Agreement, including notice period and salary, shall apply uniformly during and after probation.  

7. Working Hours  
The Employee shall work thirty-eight (38) scheduled hours per week, distributed across five (5) working days as determined by the Employer. The Employee may be required to work additional hours when necessary to meet operational demands, subject to compliance with applicable labor laws.  

8. Leave  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave benefits in accordance with applicable statutory provisions, including but not limited to earned leave, sick leave, and public holidays as recognized by law. Leave accrual, carry-forward, and encashment shall be governed by applicable laws and the Employer’s internal policies, as updated from time to time.  

9. Applicable Statutory Benefits  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under applicable central and state laws, including but not limited to provident fund, gratuity, and employee insurance, subject to eligibility criteria and contribution requirements. The Employer shall comply with all mandatory statutory obligations in relation to these benefits.  

10. Confidentiality  
The Employee shall not, during or after employment, disclose, use, or authorize the use of any confidential or proprietary information of the Employer, including technical data, business strategies, client information, or internal processes, except as necessary to perform duties under this Agreement. This obligation shall continue after termination of employment, to the extent permitted by law.  

11. Work-Related Intellectual Property  
All intellectual property created, developed, or discovered by the Employee during the course of employment, in connection with the Employer’s business, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee shall promptly disclose and assign such intellectual property to the Employer and provide all necessary assistance for its protection.  

12. Workplace Policies  
The Employee shall comply with all current and future workplace policies, codes of conduct, IT security protocols, and health and safety guidelines issued by the Employer, as communicated from time to time. Breach of such policies may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination.  

13. Termination  
Either party may terminate this employment by providing ninety (90) days’ prior written notice or payment of salary in lieu of notice. Termination shall not affect rights accrued prior to such termination. The Employer reserves the right to place the Employee on garden leave during the notice period.  

14. Dispute Resolution  
Any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved amicably through good-faith discussions. If unresolved, the dispute shall be referred to the competent courts or tribunals in Odisha, India.  

15. Governing Law  
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India, as applicable in the state of Odisha.  

16. Employer and Employee Signatures  
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement on the date first written above.  

_________________________  
[E] [Employer Name]  
By: Authorized Signatory  
Date: [Date]  

_________________________  
[I] [Employee Name]  
Employee  
Date: [Date]
